x1xtr747.baseName: COSTWAY 6FT Pre-Lit Snow flocked Artificial Christmas Tree - Green & White
x1xtr747.variantName: COSTWAY 6FT Pre-Lit Snow flocked Artificial Christmas Tree - Green & White
x1xtr747.sourceDescription: With 600 branch tips and snow-flocked leaves, this tree just like an real tree perfectly kissed by snow, making it an eye-catching decoration during the holidays. It is crafted of non-flammable PVC material, which is resistant to pressure and not deformed easily for a long lifespan. Iron stand makes the tree stable without tilting. What's more, the branches are connected to the trunk by hinges to set up effortlessly in a short time. 250 LED lights will add a warm and charming feeling, bringing vitality to the room. It is perfect for home, office, shop and more. Selected PVC with Snow Flocked Design: This lush Christmas tree is made of environmental-friendly and non-flammable PVC material, which is harmless and safe to use. Besides, the leaves with realistic flocked snow create a unique winter feeling, making the whole tree leafier and fluffier. Pre-lit LED Lights: This Christmas tree is equipped with 250 LED lights with warm white color, which is energy-efficient and long lasting. And UKCA certified adapter is safe to use. Glowing warmly from the centerpiece tree's branches can provide the perfect brightness, creating a soft and calm mood for the room. Easy to Assemble with Hinged Design: In a few simple steps, this Christmas tree with 3 sections is easy to assemble, disassemble and store. And the hinged branches will expand easier to save your time and energy. Just arrange it a little, hang the decorations, and a beautiful Christmas tree is finished. Dense Branches for Versatility: With 600 branch tips and snow flocked leaves, this full-bodied Christmas tree is like a real tree covered with snow. The 6 ft stereoscopic tree is an attractive addition to blend perfectly with the winter scenery. It is ideal for home, shops, schools, etc. Sturdy Metal Stand: Compared with other cheap plastic base, the reinforced metal stand will provide the tree with greater support and ensure good stability. Foldable X-shaped stand can keep the tree standing upright and prevent the tree from falling. And non-slip foot pads can protect the floor from scratches. Specifications Colour: Green + White Material: PVC, Metal Overall Dimensions: 90 x 180 cm (W x H) Number of LED: 250 Number of PVC Tips: 600 Number of Overall Parts: 3 Net Weight: 6 kg Box Qty:1(May vary by batch) Retain instructions for future reference.always place the product on a flat, steady and stable surface.keep all small parts and packaging materials for this product away from babies and children as they potentially pose a serious choking hazard. FDS CORPORATION LIMITED Unit 4, Blackacre Road, Great Blakenham, Ipswich, United Kingdom, IP6 0FL

jhfgjceh.variantName: Christmas Tree World 4ft Celestara Fibre Optic Tree - Multicolour
jhfgjceh.sourceDescription: The 4ft Celestara Fibre Optic Christmas Tree features green artificial foliage with 125 branch tips and an overall width of approximately 60cm. Integrated multicolour fibre optics are accompanied by starburst-style lighting clusters that emit red, blue and white light. The lighting system offers 13 settings and operates silently without moving mechanical parts. Attached branches and a plastic stand support the structure, while the mains-powered lighting includes a 1.85m lead. The tree is intended for indoor use and features certified fire-retardant foliage. Read the operating instructions before use. Keep away from heat sources. Christmas Tree World Unit 3, Enfield Industrial Estate Enfield Street, Wigan, Greater Manchester WN5 8DB

cbwttbc1.sourceDescription: This beautiful artificial Christmas tree is very lifelike in its shape and appearance and is meant to create just the right atmosphere for this Christmas. 8 lighting modes: The Christmas tree has 8 different lighting effects (combination, in wave, sequential, slow glow, chasing/running water, slow fade, twinkle/flash, and steady on). Good to know:You can customise your Christmas tree by hanging the LED string light yourself, as they are provided separately.The product has a USB connector that requires a certified 5V USB power source (not included).Please ensure that the USB connection is plugged in a dry environment. Recommended Uses: Whether displayed in a living room, garden, or terrace, this tree is perfectly suited for creating holiday cheer in any environment. Its elegant lighting effect makes it a superb choice for evening gatherings, fostering a warm and inviting atmosphere for family and guests during the festive season. Care &Maintenance: To protect your decorative investment, place a cover over the tree when not in use to shield it from dust and potential damage.
